```plato

    // The nearest points to the query centre, nearest first, paired with their
    // distances.
    FindNearest(self: KdTree2D, query: KNearestQuery2D): NearestNeighbors {
        var count = self.NeighborResultCount(query);
        var chosen = count.MapRange(r => self.NeighborAtRank(query.Center, r));
        return (chosen.Map(i => self.PointIndices[i]),
                chosen.Map(i => self.Points[i].Distance(query.Center)));
    }
```
